description.zh-CN: 按 Ctrl+Alt+P 或在待办上右键开始一个番茄钟，结束时在岛上提示，可以点“再来一轮”。完成的轮数保存在插件存储里。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Press Ctrl+Alt+P or right-click a todo to start a pomodoro; when it ends the island shows a message with One more round. Finished rounds are kept in plugin storage. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

description.zh-CN: 待办变化时在日志里记录未完成待办的数量；点“写入摘要”会把未完成的待办追加到每日笔记。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行，不需要另外安装任何东西。
description.en: Logs how many todos are open whenever they change; Write digest appends the open todos to the daily note. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows, so nothing else needs installing.
